units.title: 把、被、就是
units.intro: HSK 3, words 1–40, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: to hold; to grasp; handlebar; classifier: handful, bundle, bunch

ex.zh: 他好心地把我送到医院。
ex.p: tā hǎo xīn de bǎ wǒ sòng dào yī yuàn
ex.en: He was kind enough to take me to the hospital.

ex.zh: 他把信读了一遍又一遍。
ex.p: tā bǎ xìn dòu le yī biàn yòu yī biàn
ex.en: He read the letter over and over.

items.en: quilt; to cover (with); (literary) to suffer (a misfortune)

ex.p: hái zi men bèi zhào gu de hěn hǎo
ex.en: The children were well looked after.

ex.zh: 它们什么时候能被送到？
ex.p: tā men shén me shí hou néng bèi sòng dào
ex.en: How soon can they be delivered?

ex.zh: 你就是我一直要找的人。
ex.p: nǐ jiù shì wǒ yī zhí yào zhǎo de rén
ex.en: You're the man I've been looking for.

ex.p: wǒ jiù shì zài zhè dé dào tā de
ex.en: I've got it right here.

ex.p: bù zhī dào tā shén me shí hou lái
ex.en: I don't know when he's coming.

ex.p: shì jiè mò rì shì shén me shí hou
ex.en: When will the world come to an end?

items.en: to need; to want; to demand; to require; needs

ex.p: rén men xū yào gēng duō de jiāo liú
ex.en: People should get more involved.

ex.zh: 你不需要提高你的音量。
ex.p: nǐ bù xū yào tí gāo nǐ de yīn liàng
ex.en: You don't have to raise your voice.

ex.p: yī kāi shǐ wǒ yǐ wéi tā bìng le
ex.en: At first, I thought they were sick.

ex.p: yī kāi shǐ wǒ yǐ wéi wǒ bìng le
ex.en: At first, I thought I was sick.

ex.p: wǒ xiǎng shàng xué bìng nǔ lì xué xí
ex.en: I want to go to school and study hard.

ex.zh: 生活并不总是如我们所愿。
ex.p: shēng huó bìng bù zǒng shì rú wǒ men suǒ yuàn
ex.en: Life doesn't always go the way we want it to.

ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ huā le suǒ yǒu qián
ex.en: Why did you use up all the money?

ex.zh: 你所有的书我都看过了。
ex.p: nǐ suǒ yǒu de shū wǒ dōu kàn guò le
ex.en: I've read all your books.

ex.p: tā men shuō tā sǐ le liǎng nián le
ex.en: They say that he has been dead for two years.

ex.p: wǒ kě néng míng tiān jiù huì sǐ le
ex.en: I might die tomorrow.

ex.zh: 不要再让这种事发生了！
ex.p: bù yào zài ràng zhè zhǒng shì fā shēng le
ex.en: Don't let that happen again!

ex.zh: 你为什么做了这种事儿？
ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me zuò le zhè zhǒng shì ér
ex.en: Why did you do such a thing?

items.en: to hope; a hope; a wish

ex.p: wǒ xī wàng nǐ dì di hǎo diǎn le
ex.en: I hope your brother is better.

ex.zh: 我希望您快就会好起来。
ex.p: wǒ xī wàng nín kuài jiù huì hǎo qǐ lai
ex.en: I hope you'll get well soon.

items.en: to happen; to occur; to take place; to break out

ex.p: shì gù fā shēng zài yī gè yǔ tiān
ex.en: The accident happened on a rainy day.

ex.p: tā men zhī dào fā shēng le shén me
ex.en: They know what happened.

items.en: for; for the purpose of; in order to

ex.p: tā zuò zhè gè shì wèi le qián
ex.en: He did it for money.

ex.zh: 他这么说就是为了开玩笑。
ex.p: tā zhè me shuō jiù shì wèi le kāi wán xiào
ex.en: He said it merely as a joke.

items.en: merely; only; just; nothing but; simply; but; however

ex.zh: 你不再只是一个孩子了。
ex.p: nǐ bù zài zhǐ shì yī gè hái zi le
ex.en: You're no longer a mere child.

ex.zh: 你要做的只是坐在这儿。
ex.p: nǐ yào zuò de zhǐ shì zuò zài zhèr
ex.en: All you have to do is sit here.

ex.p: rén yīng gāi míng bai shì jiè zài biàn
ex.en: People should understand that the world is changing.

ex.p: zhè shì shì jiè shǎng zuì dà de chē
ex.en: This is the biggest car in the world.

ex.p: wǒ bù jì de shì gù de qíng kuàng
ex.en: I don't remember anything about the incident.

ex.zh: 请把真实的情况说出来。
ex.p: qǐng bǎ zhēn shí de qíng kuàng shuō chū lái
ex.en: Please tell the truth.

ex.p: wǒ men qù kàn le bǐ sài
ex.en: We went to the races.

ex.p: bǐ sài jī diǎn kāi shǐ
ex.en: What time will the game start?

items.en: to continue; to proceed with; to go on with

ex.zh: 我们要继续我们的工作。
ex.p: wǒ men yào jì xù wǒ men de gōng zuò
ex.en: We have to continue to do our jobs.

ex.p: qǐng jì xù jiǎng nǐ de gù shì
ex.en: Please go on with your story.

ex.zh: 今晚我没心情出去吃饭。
ex.p: jīn wǎn wǒ méi xīn qíng chū qù chī fàn
ex.en: I don't feel like eating out this evening.

ex.p: nǐ jīn tiān kàn shang qu hěn kāi xīn
ex.en: You look happy today.

ex.p: nǐ yǐ jīng zhī dào le bù shì ma
ex.en: You knew about this already, didn't you?

ex.p: tā yǐ jīng wǔ tiān bù shàng xué le
ex.en: She's been absent from school for five days.

ex.zh: 我买了两张音乐会的票。
ex.p: wǒ mǎi le liǎng zhāng yīn yuè huì de piào
ex.en: I bought two tickets for a concert.

ex.zh: 我在这张地图上的哪里？
ex.p: wǒ zài zhè zhāng dì tú shǎng de nǎ lǐ
ex.en: Where am I on this map?

ex.zh: 你的问题和我没有关系。
ex.p: nǐ de wèn tí hé wǒ méi yǒu guān xi
ex.en: Your problems don't concern me.

ex.zh: 我跟那个事件没有什么关系。
ex.p: wǒ gēn nà gè shì jiàn méi yǒu shén me guān xi
ex.en: I had nothing to do with that incident.

ex.zh: 您可以在三天内完成吗？
ex.p: nín kě yǐ zài sān tiān nèi wán chéng ma
ex.en: Can you finish this in three days?

ex.zh: 不可能短时间内学会英语。
ex.p: bù kě néng duǎn shí jiān nèi xué huì yīng yǔ
ex.en: It is impossible to master English in a short time.

items.en: general; overall; to sum up; in every case; always; invariably

ex.p: tā de zhǔ yi zǒng shì kě xíng de
ex.en: His ideas are always practical.

ex.zh: 我总是在上学前先吃饭。
ex.p: wǒ zǒng shì zài shàng xué qián xiān chī fàn
ex.en: I always eat before going to school.

ex.zh: 不是每个人都是老实的。
ex.p: bù shì měi gè rén dōu shì lǎo shi de
ex.en: Not everyone is honest.

ex.zh: 为什么你每天都学习呢？
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ měi tiān dōu xué xí ne
ex.en: Why do you study every day?

items.en: the Americas (abbr. for 洲); USA (abbr. for 美国)

ex.zh: 在美国人们说哪些语言？
ex.p: zài měi guó rén men shuō nǎ xiē yǔ yán
ex.en: What languages are spoken in America?

ex.p: zài měi guó xiào chē shì huáng sè de
ex.en: In the United States, school buses are yellow.

ex.p: wǒ xī wàng zuì hòu yī qiè dōu hǎo
ex.en: I hope everything will be fine in the end.

ex.zh: 这是你所能做的一切了。
ex.p: zhè shì nǐ suǒ néng zuò de yī qiè le
ex.en: It's all you can really do.

items.en: to follow; from; because of; due to

ex.zh: 我没有特别的理由去做。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu tè bié de lǐ yóu qù zuò
ex.en: I have no particular reason to do so.

ex.p: nà jiù shì tā shēng qì de lǐ yóu
ex.en: That's why he got angry.

ex.zh: 他这么做，没有任何不安。
ex.p: tā zhè me zuò méi yǒu rèn hé bù ān
ex.en: He had no qualms in doing so.

ex.zh: 我再也不相信任何人了！
ex.p: wǒ zài yě bù xiāng xìn rèn hé rén le
ex.en: I can't believe anyone anymore.

items.en: to decide (to do something); to resolve; decision

ex.p: wǒ jué dìng gēng nǔ lì de xué xí
ex.en: I made up my mind to study harder.

ex.p: mǎi bù mǎi yóu nǐ jué dìng
ex.en: It's up to you whether to buy it or not.

ex.zh: 只有你回答了这个问题。
ex.p: zhǐ yǒu nǐ huí dá le zhè gè wèn tí
ex.en: Only you answered the question.

ex.zh: 只有成人可以看那种电影。
ex.p: zhǐ yǒu chéng rén kě yǐ kàn nà zhǒng diàn yǐng
ex.en: Only adults may watch that film.

ex.p: tā zhī dào rú hé zuò shōu yīn jī
ex.en: He knows how to make a radio.

ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào rú hé shǐ yòng tā
ex.en: I don't know how to use it.

items.en: to receive; to accept; to suffer

ex.p: wǒ shòu bù liǎo zhè dà rè tiān le
ex.en: I can't put up with the heat any longer.

ex.p: tā jiē shòu le wǒ de zhǔ yi
ex.en: He accepted my idea.

items.en: to make; to cause; to enable

ex.p: wǒ jīn chén kàn jiàn yī wèi tiān shǐ
ex.en: This morning, I saw an angel.

ex.zh: 他使他儿子成了个有钱人。
ex.p: tā shǐ tā ér zi chéng le gè yǒu qián rén
ex.en: He made his son a wealthy man.

ex.zh: 这种说法其实有点可疑。
ex.p: zhè zhǒng shuō fǎ qí shí yǒu diǎn kě yí
ex.en: This statement is actually kind of suspicious.

ex.zh: 他常常坐着看书一连好几个小时。
ex.p: tā cháng cháng zuò zhe kàn shū yī lián hǎo jī gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: He often sits for many hours reading books.

ex.p: lián xiǎo háir dū huì zuò
ex.en: Even a child could do it.

items.en: only natural; as it should be; certainly

ex.p: dāng rán zhè zhǐ shì gè wán xiào
ex.en: That was a joke, of course.

ex.zh: 我理所当然地觉得，他会通过考试。
ex.p: wǒ lǐ suǒ dāng rán de jué de tā huì tōng guò kǎo shì
ex.en: I took it for granted that he would pass the exam.

ex.zh: 他们是从法国南部来的。
ex.p: tā men shì cóng fǎ guó nán bù lái de
ex.en: They come from the south of France.

ex.zh: 我已经看过这部电影了。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ jīng kàn guò zhè bù diàn yǐng le
ex.en: I have seen the film before.

ex.p: tā hái méi tīng dào zhè gè xiāo xi
ex.en: She's not yet heard the news.

ex.zh: 我只是听到了一些消息。
ex.p: wǒ zhǐ shì tīng dào le yī xiē xiāo xi
ex.en: I just heard something.

items.en: to show; to show off; to display

ex.p: tā biǎo xiàn de xiàng fēng le yī yàng
ex.en: He behaves as if he were insane.

units.title: 解决、成功、结束
units.intro: HSK 3, words 41–80, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: to solve; to resolve; to settle (a problem)

ex.p: wǒ míng bai zěn me jiě jué wèn tí
ex.en: I understand how to solve the problem.

ex.zh: 请找到问题的解决方法。
ex.p: qǐng zhǎo dào wèn tí de jiě jué fāng fǎ
ex.en: Please find a solution to the problem.

items.en: Chenggong or Chengkung town in Taitung County 台东县, southeast Taiwan

ex.p: wǒ hěn gāo xìng nǐ men chéng gōng le
ex.en: I am glad that you have succeeded.

ex.zh: 我很高兴知道你成功了。
ex.p: wǒ hěn gāo xìng zhī dào nǐ chéng gōng le
ex.en: I was glad to hear of your success.

ex.p: shén me shí hou cái jié shù a
ex.en: When will it end?

ex.p: xiàn zài jià qī jié shù le
ex.en: The vacation is over now.

items.en: (after a verb or adjective) one who (is) ...

ex.p: zhè běn xiǎo shuō de zuò zhě shì shéi
ex.en: Who's the author of this story?

ex.p: nǐ huò zhě wǒ huì bèi xuǎn zhōng
ex.en: You or I will be chosen.

ex.zh: 请在下一个十字路口右转。
ex.p: qǐng zài xià yī gè shí zì lù kǒu yòu zhuǎi
ex.en: Turn right at the next intersection.

ex.p: xià yī gè jiē jué zuǒ zhuǎi
ex.en: Turn left at the next corner.

ex.p: diào chá xià zhè gè
ex.en: Examine this.

ex.p: jǐng chá diào chá shì gù de yuán yīn
ex.en: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.

ex.zh: 他适应了新的生活方式。
ex.p: tā shì yìng le xīn de shēng huó fāng shì
ex.en: He got accustomed to the new way of living.

ex.zh: 她不喜欢我说话的方式。
ex.p: tā bù xǐ huan wǒ shuō huà de fāng shì
ex.en: She doesn't like the way I speak.

ex.zh: 我在这东西上花了十美元。
ex.p: wǒ zài zhè dōng xī shǎng huā le shí měi yuán
ex.en: I spent 10 dollars on it.

ex.p: wǒ zhǐ huā le sān měi yuán
ex.en: I only spent three dollars.

items.en: to handle; to deal with; to punish

ex.zh: 我们要快点处理这问题。
ex.p: wǒ men yào kuài diǎn chǔ lǐ zhè wèn tí
ex.en: We've got to do something about this problem soon.

ex.p: suàn shù chǔ lǐ shù zì
ex.en: Arithmetic deals with numbers.

ex.p: wǒ xiǎng tè bié qiáng diào zhè yī diǎn
ex.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.

ex.p: lǎo rén bǎo chí qiáng jiàn hěn zhòng yào
ex.en: It is important for old people to stay strong.

ex.zh: 他有能力比我做得更好。
ex.p: tā yǒu néng lì bǐ wǒ zuò de gēng hǎo
ex.en: He can do it better than I can.

ex.p: tā méi néng lì zuò zhè gè gōng zuò
ex.en: He will not be able to do the work.

items.en: to protect; to defend; to safeguard

ex.zh: 他认为他不需要他们的保护。
ex.p: tā rèn wéi tā bù xū yào tā men de bǎo hù
ex.en: He did not think he needed their protection.

ex.p: nǐ méi yǒu bǎo hù wǒ
ex.en: You didn't protect me.

ex.p: bù guǎn shì shéi zǒng bǐ méi rén hǎo
ex.en: Anybody would be better than nobody.

ex.p: wǒ bù néng zài guǎn zhè wèn tí le
ex.en: I can't deal with this problem anymore.

items.en: to be in favor of; to support; to back

ex.p: wǒ quán xīn quán yì de zhī chí nǐ
ex.en: I support you whole-heartedly.

ex.zh: 我不期望，他们能够支持我的观点。
ex.p: wǒ bù qī wàng tā men néng gòu zhī chí wǒ de guān diǎn
ex.en: I don't expect that they will support my view.

items.en: to take note of; to pay attention to

ex.zh: 你应该更注意你说的话。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi gēng zhù yì nǐ shuō de huà
ex.en: You should pay more attention to what you say.

ex.p: nǐ yào zhù yì bù yào tài zì xìn
ex.en: You should be careful not to become overconfident.

ex.p: tā men guò zhe hé píng de shēng huó
ex.en: They live in peace.

ex.p: wǒ xué huì le bù kào tā shēng huó
ex.en: I learned to live without her.

items.en: to pat; to clap; to slap

ex.zh: 用你的手机拍一张照片。
ex.p: yòng nǐ de shǒu jī pāi yī zhāng zhào piàn
ex.en: Take a picture with your phone.

ex.zh: 我们可以在大楼里拍照吗？
ex.p: wǒ men kě yǐ zài dà lóu lǐ pāi zhào ma
ex.en: Is it all right to take pictures in this building?

ex.zh: 我整个下午都在花园里。
ex.p: wǒ zhěng gè xià wǔ dōu zài huā yuán lǐ
ex.en: I was in the garden all afternoon.

ex.p: zhěng gè shì jiè dōu xū yào hé píng
ex.en: The entire world desires peace.

ex.p: tā de yīng yǔ hǎo jí le
ex.en: Her English is excellent.

ex.zh: 我们有个好极了的团队。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu gè hǎo jí le de tuán duì
ex.en: We have a great team.

ex.zh: 我们保证我们不会再做了。
ex.p: wǒ men bǎo zhèng wǒ men bù huì zài zuò le
ex.en: We promise you we'll never do it again.

ex.p: wǒ bǎo zhèng wǒ huì zuò de
ex.en: I promise I'll do it.

ex.p: gēn běn bù kě néng zuò nà jiàn shì
ex.en: Doing that is simply out of the question.

ex.p: tā gēn běn jiù méi yǒu xué xí
ex.en: He didn't study at all.

ex.zh: 东京是一个很大的城市。
ex.p: dōng jīng shì yī gè hěn dà de chéng shì
ex.en: Tokyo is a big city.

ex.zh: 你的学校在这个城市吗？
ex.p: nǐ de xué xiào zài zhè gè chéng shì ma
ex.en: Is your school in this town?

ex.p: mù qián wǒ wèn tí hěn duō
ex.en: I have a lot of problems at the moment.

ex.zh: 他和他的姐妹们目前都住在东京。
ex.p: tā hé tā de jiě mèi men mù qián dōu zhù zài dōng jīng
ex.en: He and his sisters are currently living in Tokyo.

ex.p: wǒ méi shí jiān gēn nǐ wán yóu xì
ex.en: I don't have time to play games with you.

ex.p: wǒ měi zhōu mò dū huì qù shì qū

ex.zh: 明天你有什么安排没有？

ex.en: Do you have any plans for tomorrow?

ex.p: wǒ xiāng xìn zhī shi jiù shì lì liang
ex.en: It's my belief that knowledge is power.

ex.p: bù yào xiǎo kàn wǒ de lì liang
ex.en: Don't underestimate my power.

items.en: to bring about; to create; to cause

ex.p: wǒ yòu shī qù le yī cì jī huì
ex.en: I've missed another chance.

ex.en: My team is always losing.

ex.p: tā yǒu kě néng yíng dé bǐ sài
ex.en: He is likely to win the game.

ex.p: wǒ mǎi le fèn yīng wén xiě de bào zhǐ

ex.p: wǒ zuì jìn yā lì yǒu diǎn dà

ex.p: tā ràng wǒ mǔ qīn zhào gu hái zi

ex.p: wǒ bù tóng yì tā yī gè rén qù nàr

items.en: at set dates; at regular intervals; periodic

ex.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

items.en: to move house; to relocate; to remove (sth)

ex.en: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.

ex.zh: 这样做你能节约几个小时。
ex.p: zhè yàng zuò nǐ néng jié yuē jī gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: If you do it this way, you can save several hours.

ex.p: qǐng jié yuē yòng diàn
ex.en: Please save electricity.

items.en: conscious; aware; on one's own initiative

ex.p: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān nuǎn huo
ex.en: It is warmer today than yesterday.

ex.p: qù nián dōng tiān hěn nuǎn huo
ex.en: We had a mild winter last year.

ex.zh: 谁也不工作。大家在看世界杯。
ex.p: shéi yě bù gōng zuò dà jiā zài kàn shì jiè bēi
ex.en: No one is working. Everyone's watching the World Cup.

ex.p: tā de yǎn shuō gǎn dòng le tīng zhòng
ex.en: Her speech moved the audience.

ex.p: wǒ men yǒu hěn duō tīng zhòng

ex.p: shuǐ fèi téng hòu biàn wéi zhēng qì

ex.en: My e-mail address has been changed.

ex.en: This is my email address.

ex.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雪。

ex.en: The forecast says it'll snow tomorrow.

ex.p: míng tiān de tiān qì yù bào zěn me shuō
ex.en: What's the forecast for tomorrow?

items.en: slow-witted; blockhead; log (of wood, timber etc)

ex.p: hǎo duō péng you hé shú rén lái le
ex.en: Quite a lot of friends and acquaintances have come.

ex.p: wǒ tài lěi le zuò bù le gōng kè
